newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT shares slide on stock sale report.
newsitem.headline: NTT shares slide on stock sale report.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) slid in early Thursday morning trade, depressed by a newspaper report that the Finance Ministry had decided to resume sales of NTT shares as early as this year, traders said.
At 0025 GMT, the share price was down 28,000 yen at 861,000. Trading volume was 4,903 shares.
On Thursday, the Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the Finance Ministry plans to sell 500,000 shares of NTT as early as this year.
It would be the first sale of NTT shares by the ministry since fiscal 1988/89.
The Finance Ministry said it would not comment on whether or not it would sell NTT shares.
